part2.question: Describe a challenging technological problem you faced

segments.v: I want to talk about a problem with my laptop last semester. I had a group presentation the next day and I had to put all the slides together. At night, my laptop suddenly stopped working. I restarted it but it didn't turn on. I tried many ways from the internet but they didn't work. It was very difficult because it was late and the shops were closed. My friends needed me. I used my dad's laptop and I found an old version of our slides on Google Drive. Then I had a video call with my friends and we made the missing slides again. We finished at 1 am. The next day, our presentation was good. Now I always save my work online.
